title: PowerRocket
description:
此模组专门为喜欢穿鞘翅飞跃世界的玩家设计，提供极致速度的同时，还集成了很多非常实用的功能。

Designed specifically for players who love flying through the world through the elytra, it offers extreme speed while integrating many very practical features.
body:
This mod is specially designed for players who love flying through the world through elytras, offering extreme speed while integrating many very practical features.

One-click takeoff, one-click switching between elytra flight and rocket launch; Automatically switches on the chest armor upon landing;

Low-altitude protection prevents crashes, low-speed protection automatically continues the flight, void protection prevents flying out of the world, and landing protection prevents falls;

Can disable Created Flight, can use vehicle acceleration; With flint in one hand and rockets in the other, it instantly transforms into a fighter jet.

Built-in firework rocket keys, functions linked. There are four trigger directions: vertical upward, vertical downward, diagonally upward at 45 degrees, and backward.

This is especially suitable for players who enjoy using spears and heavy hammers. By default, double quotes (") open module settings.

Regarding the recipes, one is the previous power rocket (or paper) plus two gunpowder and one flame round, and the other is power rocket 5 plus Dragon's Breath, Flame Staff, and Soul's Tear.

Additionally, several practical HUD display features have been added, such as speed, altitude, coordinates, orientation, and more.
